about: Usha Martin Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel wires, strands, wire ropes, wire drawing and allied machine, cord, and related accessories in India and internationally. The company offers wire ropes, including crane, mining, elevator, oil and offshore, fishing, general engineering, aerial transportation, structural, and forestry ropes, as well as conveyor cords. It also provides spring, welding, fencing, ACSR, needle, mesh, fishhook, CHQ, spoke, and brush wires;
